run_compute_scaling_factors: run the compute_scaling_factors function to fit all ScaleFactor modules in a FairChem model using training batches
run_fit_cli: run the fit.py CLI module with argparse flags to compute and save scaling factors to a checkpoint file
test_train_batch: test the _train_batch function to perform a no-gradient forward pass and loss computation on a single batch
review_prefilled_input: review the _prefilled_input helper that uses readline to prefill a prompt with default text before user input
refactor_compute_scaling_factors: refactor compute_scaling_factors to support non-interactive mode by removing the input prompts for fitted scale factor selection
